name: Ennis Plaza

description: Ennis Plaza is a neighborhood shopping center located at 1012 East Ennis Avenue in Ennis, Texas, serving the local community with convenient retail and service options. Managed by Available For Lease, a professional retail leasing and property management company with over 25 years of experience in the Houston and Dallas markets, the plaza offers accessible shopping in a well-maintained open-air format. The property management team specializes in multi-tenant retail properties and provides comprehensive services including rent collection, tenant management, and property oversight. Ennis Plaza features available lease spaces suitable for both mom-and-pop businesses and national tenants, making it an attractive location for retailers seeking to serve the Ennis community. With its strategic location on East Ennis Avenue and professional management, the center provides a reliable retail destination for local residents seeking everyday goods and services.
